blocks.x: Research throughput up 2.8x — governed HPC/cloud platform
A multi-campus university group, Education & Research sector, outcome-linked engagement, blended delivery team. Figures are the client's own, shared with permission.
Labs bought cloud haphazardly; HPC queues ungoverned.
Research-data governance varied by department. Quantum access concentrated elsewhere; groups lacked structured on-ramps.

The research computing platform consolidated HPC/cloud burst with queue governance and cost telemetry per group; the research data commons applied ethics-aware access control; and Quanta's quantum curriculum on-ramp gave groups cloud-accessible labs with classical-baseline discipline.

blocks.x: Colleagues ask what the multi-campus university group program proves.
